name: David Chen
psychographics: Independent and routine-focused; treats the road as his office and values efficiency over small talk.
current_solutions: Google Maps for routing; Audible for audiobooks during long hauls; truck stop cafeteria for meals.
frustration: Sat at a closed motorway service station at 02:15am looking for a 24-hour ATM; the screen said 'out of service' and he had to drive 15 miles to find cash.
decision_style: Compares fuel prices on trucking forums; rarely switches brands without a significant price gap.
voice: Concise and gruff; uses industry jargon like 'detention time' and 'deadhead' without explaining it.
